# Review - PR 580 @ 73674f5e3576fc8f2d8778bd3087d8747303c2c1

Bounded F1 recheck (no new full review opened; the accepted proof, code and explicit supplied-witness blueprint scope evidence of review 5240952565 at 4bd78e34 stands).

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: dfc0a5fb29c1e5db070538cd59bdbb90025f1fee. The whole delta since the reviewed head is a ten-line YAML front matter block prepended to the recovered issue 517 audit file (commit 0b429510) plus a merge of main that touches nothing in the PR's own patch.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Base is main; own patch taken against merge-base 14752aaf (base of 73674f5e), prior head 4bd78e34 against its merge-base 0f437c45. Worktree HEAD equals the published head and is clean, so all reads are of the published head.

F1 (missing YAML front matter in `audits/2026-09-12_nonencoding-marginal-mass-517.md`) is now addressed. Checked against `audits/2026-04-29_audit-document-format.md` as read from github/main: the file opens with a `---` fenced block that `yaml.safe_load` parses to a mapping; `title` is a quoted string, `date` is a valid `YYYY-MM-DD` value (2026-09-12, matching the leading date in the file name, which follows the required `YYYY-MM-DD_` convention), `purpose` is a folded scalar giving one sentence on what the audit records, and the optional `issue: "#517"` / `pr: "#580"` fields are present as quoted strings exactly as the format doc requires so YAML does not read them as comments. No required field is missing; the doc's optional classification fields are legitimately omitted ("prefer the minimal header above"). The audit's own section headings (Record and scope, Statement integrity, Mathematical proof and provenance, Historical effort and validation, September 18 preservation checks) depart from the template's default section list, but the format doc allows a deliberately narrower audit and that body was already accepted at the previous head, so this is not raised as a new finding.

Byte identity of the rest of the file: `sha256` of the file at the current head with the ten new leading lines stripped equals `sha256` of the whole file at 4bd78e34 (d3cf172f5bb5c12bf1bfab3b8b3dedcf7f5fb47cb81b4b9081a2eac77b0c4eb4) - the recovered body is untouched.

Nothing else in the PR's own patch changed: diffing the full own-patch at the current head against the full own-patch at 4bd78e34 yields exactly one hunk difference, the ten added front matter lines (127 -> 137 lines in that new file), and an index line. The other four files (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`) are identical to the reviewed versions, so the merge of main brought no PR-side change and no proof or blueprint text moved. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` was introduced by this delta (the delta is markdown metadata only).

Exact-head CI is green: `gh api .../commits/73674f5e/status` reports overall `success` with all nine contexts success (local-ci/build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin, summary).

Not re-checked, by design of this bounded recheck: the Lean proof content, the blueprint scope wording and the paper-gap prose, all of which carry the unchanged evidence of review 5240952565; no Lean elaboration was re-run because no Lean file changed since that review and exact-head CI build is green.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
